description: This file contains acceptance testing code for the Locations module within the SuiteCRM project, using Codeception framework. It defines a test class LocationsCest which includes setup and two test scenarios for viewing and creating location entries.

classes.name: LocationsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for Locations module, including setup and test scenarios.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, initializes fake data generator and seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewLocationsModule
methods.description: Test to verify the locations module list view is accessible and displays correct title.

methods.description: Test to create and delete a location entry, ensuring standard fields work correctly.
